problem: Learn transferable temporal robot representations from large human-video corpora instead of relying only on static visual pretraining.
contribution: GR-1 is a GPT-style language/observation/proprioception model pretrained to predict future images, then supervised to predict robot actions plus images. It is a predictive policy representation, not an independently action-conditioned simulator or online self-improving controller.
algorithm: Frozen CLIP text and MAEViT encoders supply global/local features; Perceiver reduces image tokens. Learned timestep,OBS andACT tokens enter a causal transformer with prediction tokens masked from context. Video decoder predicts future patches withMSE; arm head usesSmoothL1 and binary gripperBCE. Pretrain onEgo4D video, then joint action/video supervised finetuning on target robot data.
observations: Language, image history and six-dimensional EEF pose plus binary gripper state. Video pretraining has no robot actions, but actual action-labeled demonstrations remain necessary during adaptation. Camera/action timing and binary-gripper semantics are embodiment-specific.
actions: DeltaXYZ and deltaEuler arm commands plus binary gripper inCALVIN. Physical target controller/action mapping details NOT_EXTRACTED from inspected main text; do not inferSO101joint mapping or grasp-force control.
embodiment_and_data: Ego4D800k sampled3-second clips/8Mframes; CALVIN~22,966language-labeled trajectories (annotated~1%of24hplay). Real data1775transport demonstrations and2856drawer trajectories from VR teleoperation. Physical arm model/evaluation denominator NOT_EXTRACTED here;CALVIN usesFrankaPanda.
experiments: ABCD→D seen-environment versusABC→D heldoutenvironment,10%data andsynonymousGPT4instructiontests. BaselinesMCIL/HULC may train onfullunlabeled+annotatedplay whileGR1/RT1/R3M useannotatedsubset. Real seeninstance/unseencategory/background disturbances and drawer tests are separate.
baselines: MCIL,HULC,RT1,multitaskR3M with matched trainable parameter count toGR1; frozenencoders. Generalization concerns scenes/objects/language on known action spaces, not a new robot arm without targettraining.

limitations: Video reconstruction omits occluded objects; drawer failures include missed handles/incomplete closure. Novelcategory performance falls substantially. Supervised future prediction does not establish causal physical laws; fixed knownembodiment actions remain needed. No uncertainty/force/independent outcome mechanism is provided.
